candidateContract: Produce exactly one answer.json file containing a JSON object of the form {"answer": <value>}, with no additional fields or prose.

tasks.prompt: Input config: {"service":{"name":"quartz","port":8087,"tls":true},"retry":{"max":3},"debug":false}. Return answer as an object with exactly these keys: service_name copied from service.name; endpoint formed as scheme://service.name:service.port where scheme is https when tls is true and http otherwise; retries copied from retry.max; debug copied unchanged.

Input config: {"timeouts":{"connect_ms":250,"read_ms":900},"retry_count":2}. Return answer as an object with exactly these keys: timeout_seconds, an object mapping connect and read to their respective millisecond values divided by 1000; and retries copied from retry_count.

Input config: {"services":[{"name":"willow","enabled":true,"priority":2},{"name":"amber","enabled":false,"priority":1},{"name":"birch","enabled":true,"priority":1},{"name":"cedar","enabled":true,"priority":1}]}. Keep only enabled services, sort by priority ascending and then name in ascending alphabetical order, and return answer as the resulting array of names.

Input config: {"workers":"4","queue":"cedar","paused":"false","region":"test-1"}. Return answer as an object with exactly these keys: workers as a base-10 integer, queue copied unchanged, paused converted to a JSON boolean, and region converted to uppercase.
Classify the input {"attempts":2}. Return answer as one string using these exact rules: attempts equal to 0 means "none"; attempts from 1 through 2 means "few"; attempts of 3 or more means "many".
Classify the input {"kind":"K2"}. Return answer as one string using this exact mapping: K1 maps to "alpha", K2 maps to "beta", K3 maps to "gamma". No other mappings are needed.

Classify the input {"urgent":false,"component":"billing"}. Return answer as one string using these ordered rules: if urgent is true, return "page"; otherwise, if component is "billing", return "billing_queue"; otherwise return "general".
Classify the input {"temperature_c":10}. Return answer as one string using these exact intervals: below 0 is "frozen"; 0 through 9 is "cool"; 10 through 29 is "mild"; 30 or above is "hot".

From the text "Order Q-17 | owner=Rin | qty=6 units", extract the order id, owner, and quantity. Return answer as an object with exactly the keys id, owner, and quantity; quantity must be a JSON number.
From the text "batch=BX-204; state=queued; zone=west-2", extract batch, state, and zone. Return answer as an object with exactly those three keys and their string values.
From the text "labels: [maple, indigo, 7]", extract the listed labels in order. Return answer as an array of strings; do not include the brackets or the word labels.

From the text "sensor=SN-8; reading=12.5; unit=units", extract the sensor id, reading, and unit. Return answer as an object with exactly the keys sensor, reading, and unit; reading must be a JSON number.
